review_scope: Independent rendered-image visual review and direct export inspection only.

review_method.earlier_candidate_images_scope: Only the preserved 96 dpi proxies from the initial independent image review, for the three requested final legend revisions.

external_checks.name: source numerical coverage and calculated statistics
external_checks.evidence: Intentionally excluded from this independent visual review. No source data, plotting code, renderer QA, or statistical check records were used.

external_checks.name: printed copy or journal acceptance
external_checks.evidence: 96 dpi PDF renders are final-size screen proxies; they are not print proof or journal assessment.

external_checks.name: baseline refinement preference
external_checks.evidence: Preserved baseline and new candidate 96 dpi PDF proxies were opened at equal final size for ECDF and both paired views. Preference is candidate for limited legend reading/style consistency; no overall aesthetic improvement is claimed.

ready_scope_note: This status concerns the inspected supplied panels and export properties only. It does not establish print proof, journal acceptance, broad aesthetic improvement beyond the limited legend comparison, or performance on other datasets.
packaging_note: Case-specific records extracted by the main agent from the independent final review. Reviewer findings and candidate hashes are unchanged. Development-only paths identify evidence retained outside this portable case.

cases.mapping: Four equally spaced unconnected point distributions, orange prior-infection pair then blue no-prior-infection pair; raw median and Q1–Q3 overlays are visible on the adopted logarithmic axis.
cases.visual_evidence: Swarm points remain individually readable in each cloud at the 397×363 proxy; black summary strokes are prominent without hiding the concentration pattern. The full two-entry bottom guide occupies about 46% of the data-region width but only one small text row, so the data remain primary. Orange/blue fills separate the two blocks.

findings.evidence: The source crop includes p-value brackets, dotted guides, sample counts, boxed IgG and a panel letter. Their omission, the narrower displayed range and the new bottom cohort guide are explicitly adopted. Median/IQR geometry, color grouping and four-position structure remain visible. The candidate-specific caption is now supplied and was read.
findings.requirement: Judge the adopted derivative rather than restoring intentionally omitted source annotations.
findings.action: Retain the adopted omissions and separate caption.

cases.mapping: A separate create view adds thin low-opacity within-participant segments to jittered orange and blue points; black median/Q1–Q3 summaries stay prominent.

Crossings make exact single-participant path lookup difficult, as expected for 127 participants; this does not conceal the four distributions or summary strokes. The point/guide layout matches the unconnected panel.

findings.evidence: Connecting segments are absent from the supplied paper crop. The new adopted brief and caption explicitly identify them as an added paired view and explain crossings.
